steps.text: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate.
Spread guacamole on 4 slices toast; spread cream cheese on remaining 4 slices toast. Divide lettuce, tomato, and bacon between 4 slices toast; top with remaining toast slices, coated sides down.

raw_recipe.headline: Super BLT
raw_recipe.description: This super BLT recipe takes an ordinary BLT to the next level with layers of crispy bacon, juicy lettuce, tomatoes, guacamole, and tangy cream cheese.
raw_recipe.name: Super BLT

review.reviewBody: I travel a lot and sometimes some of the best recipes I've come across here on AR have been when I'm heading out again and I do a simple ingredient search for recipes that are quick, easy and to use up things I have in the fridge. This was a BLT sandwich LUXE! Over the top good, and quite pretty too. I used homemade Italian bread and, I confess, considerably more of ALL the ingredients than the submitter directed for each sandwich - like probably double. If you aren't as lucky as I was to happen to have leftover guacamole laying around I'm sure that avocado slices would be great too, although the guacamole provides incredible flavor. The bacon is a "gimme" in my book as I think no matter what you use it for it makes it taste better! Combine that bacon with good bread, the creaminess of the cream cheese, more creaminess and flavor from the guacamole, the crunchiness of the lettuce and the juiciness of a red-ripe tomato and you've got yourself one outstanding sandwich. I could easily see this as a wrap too, either using tortillas or simply large lettuce leaves. So glad for the leftovers and search that led me to this recipe!

This sandwich is so good! I used a simple homemade guacamole, thick sliced bacon, and whipped cream cheese. I cooked the bacon in a covered microwave bacon cooker making that part really easy. This may sound totally odd, but I ate it using Chef Johns Pumpkin Bread from Allrecipes. It was awesome. I do plan to make it again.

This is one "Super" BLT! And to say that is really saying something because I've had a lot of them in my lifetime! Combining bacon, lettuce and tomato is just as classic a combination as peanut butter and jelly in my book. But, this combination of flavors and textures takes this classic to a whole new level! It's creamy and crunchy! I used thick cut smoked bacon, crisp iceburg lettuce, tomatoes seasoned with cracked black pepper, Philly whipped cream cheese, and "Guacamole" by Bob Cody from this site. I put it all on thick slices of toast. If you try this one, prepare your tastebuds for a treat. What a sandwich!

Made the Recipe for a picnic style event. Got so many compliments. As I didn't have much time to make the sandwiches on the day of the event, I baked the bacon the day before. I also made homemade guacamole the day before - laying a piece of plastic wrap directly on guacamole itself (to keep it from browning) before storing in the fridge. Assembly the next day took only minutes. Sandwiches traveled well. Definitely worth making again. If you have the time, I definitely reccomend using homemade gaucamole.

I cut the servings back to make just one sandwich. Because I did not have any actual cream cheese at the moment, I used Laughing Cow cheese in it's place. Because i'm eating low carb, I used one side of a Bagel Thin (sandwich slices). The ingredients for one sandwich fit really nicely on one slice of bagel--I was quite surprized. This was quite good. I'll make this again. Very filling.

Really good. I added a little turkey breast and red onion as well. 
The flavor of this was perfect.
Great sandwich. I used a hot guacamole and I also buttered the top of the bread and toasted it in the oven prior to preparing the sandwiches. Turned out excellent.

This was amazing. I used this on a wholemeal bagel, and used avocado spread instead of guacamole. Turned out amazing!! If your bread is chewy/thick, make sure the bacon is extra crisp so that it breaks off easily and doesn't make the sandwich difficult to bite off! (: Thanks for the recipe.
Very good. I toast those sandwich thins instead of bread, cook bacon in the oven for ease, and sometimes mix in garden/veggie cream cheese for more flavor. Yum.

wow killer sandwich. i made my own guacamole and used garlic and chive cream cheese since its what i had. i made this for my husband who prefers a club sandwich to a plain old blt but i was out of turkey. this would be a great pub dinner night sandwich served with fries. ill make it for him again. dont skip the cream cheese it really adds something.
These were delicious and filling. Made one with veggie bacon and the rest with regular bacon and we all liked ours. Servved with coleslaw and sweet potato fries with chipotle mayo. Thanks!
This sandwich is GREAT!! It is a simple perfect recipe. The cream cheese was genius!!! I am new to “The All Recipe” App. I am staying for good!!!
Don't be shy on the toppings! Add lots of everything to balance with the thickness of the bread or, like I found out the hard way, you will mostly taste the bread.
This is awesome!
Easy, fast, tasty! Will make it again
One of my top go to sandwich recipes. Very good and filling. Used toasted fresh sour dough bread.
Tasty and filling
I did enjoy this, but I feel like there is a little part of me that just missed the "usual" mayo for the BLT. I did really like the guacamole addition though!
Absolutely fabulous!
Really good.
